**Important choice \#2: choosing how to prepare for your exam**

The exams are hard. Choosing the right preparation method

can make the difference between passing and failing.

| Instructor-Led Course | On-Demand E-Learning | Independent Study |
| :---: | :---: | :---: |
| The highest pass rates of any prep method. Instructors keep you on schedule, share tips, and work through tough concepts with you. | Flexible for busy HR lives. Requires discipline, as there's no one to answer your questions or keep you accountable. | The most affordable option, but candidates who go it alone with text prep materials make up the largest share of those who have to retake. |

**Certification best practices we couldn’t recommend more**

1. Research the certifying institutes and requirements. [View our Certification Comparison Chart.](https://www.hr.com/en/certifications/certification-guidelines_icnmg6la.html)

   

2. Verify you qualify for the exam you have selected.

   

3. Enroll in a prep program that offers a money-back guarantee.

   

4. Allow 4-6 months of preparation time.

   

5. In addition to studying for the exam bodies of knowledge, sharpen your test-taking skills.

   

6. SOMETHING HERE ABOUT WHEN TO PAY FOR EXAM

   

7. After you achieve your certification of choice, don’t wait too long to get started on recertification (required every 3 years).
